team_context: Payments squad, sprint 24 of the self-serve billing project
content:
Maya Chen: Okay everyone, this is sprint 24 planning. The sprint goal is the self-serve billing page, so let's walk the board.
Maya Chen: First, scope. We've decided to drop the invoice PDF export from this sprint and move it to sprint 25.
Daniel Ortiz: Fine by me, that frees up a lot of time.
Maya Chen: Second, after last week's evaluation the final call is that we're going with Paddle as the billing provider.
Priya Nair: For the record I still think Stripe's API is nicer, but okay, Paddle it is.
Maya Chen: Third, from now on every billing PR needs two reviewers before it can be merged. Everyone agree?
Tom Becker: Agreed.
Lena Fischer: Agreed.
Daniel Ortiz: I'll build the plan selection component, it should be ready by Thursday.
Priya Nair: I'll own the Paddle webhook handler and get it merged by end of next week.
Tom Becker: I'll write the database migration for the subscriptions table tomorrow.
Lena Fischer: I'll set up the end-to-end test suite for checkout by Friday.
Sam Okafor: I'll update the pricing copy on the marketing site this week.
Maya Chen: Tom, please send the migration plan to the DBA team for review before you run it.
Maya Chen: Priya, can you get the sandbox API keys from Paddle today?
Daniel Ortiz: Sam, I need you to confirm the final plan names with marketing by Wednesday.
Maya Chen: Lena, please add the billing scenarios to the regression checklist.
Priya Nair: Tom, can you also add a unique index on customer id in that migration?
Maya Chen: Daniel, please document the component API in the design system docs.
Lena Fischer: Sam, could you share the pricing page analytics with me?
Maya Chen: Priya, please schedule a security review of the webhook endpoint with the security team.
Tom Becker: Heads up, I'm blocked on the staging database. I still don't have write access and I've asked IT twice already this week.
Lena Fischer: I'm worried that if the Paddle sandbox doesn't support proration, we won't be able to test plan upgrades before launch.
Daniel Ortiz: There's also a real risk we miss the sprint goal if the design for the plan page isn't finalized by Tuesday.
Maya Chen: Good flags. Let's wrap there, thanks everyone.
